title: Aerospace companies ask for Pasulka's angel data

tellings.quote: inquiries from people at aerospace companies and not just one I got a lot

plain: Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion, says that around 2012, while she was researching beliefs about angels and similar beings, people at aerospace companies started contacting her to ask for her data. She tells it from her own experience and stresses it was "not just one, I got a lot," which would suggest the aerospace world had a quiet interest in her work.
